## Findings
- claim-1: For \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\) with \(t>r+s-n\), \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) is the unique bigrassmannian \(v_1\cdots v_n\in S_n\) with \(\Des(v)=\{(r\leftrightarrow r+1)\}\), \(\Des(v^{-1})=\{(s\leftrightarrow s+1)\}\), \(v_t=s+1\), and \[ v_{r,s,t,n}=(1,\ldots,t-1,\ s+1,\ldots,s+r-t+1,\ t,\ldots,s,\ s+r-t+2,\ldots,n). \] [source-2@L973-L992|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: The source sets \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), and states that \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) is \(r\)-grassmannian and corresponds to the \(j\times i\) rectangle \(i^j\). [source-2@L1354-L1362|claim=formal-document]
- claim-3: In the integral symmetric-function setting, \(\Lambda=\Lambda_{\mathbb Z}(x_1,x_2,\ldots)\); \(I_{r,n-r}\) is the ideal spanned by \(s_\lambda\) for \(\lambda\not\subseteq(n-r)^r\), and \(\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\cong H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\). The source states that \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) is generated as an ideal of this quotient by \(\{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(n-r)^r\}\). [source-2@L1310-L1325|claim=formal-document] [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document]
- claim-4: Theorem 5.4 sets \[ a=\min(n-r-i,r-j),\qquad b=\min(i,j), \] and gives the two generating sets \[ \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}, \qquad \{s_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\} \] for \(J_v\) as an ideal of \(H^\star(G/P_J,\mathbb Z)\cong\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\). [source-2@L1380-L1402|claim=formal-document]
- claim-5: Both displayed Theorem 5.4 families have \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) elements; their degree generating function is \(q^{ij}\qbin{a+b}{a}\). [source-2@L1407-L1421|claim=formal-document]
- claim-6: The formal conjecture is: “The two generating sets for the ideal \(J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) given in Theorem [5.4] are both minimal.” The authors report computer verification only for all bigrassmannian permutations with \(r\le4\) and \(n-r\le5\). [source-2@L1489-L1502|claim=formal-document]
- claim-7: With \(\Lambda=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Lambda_n\) the graded ring of symmetric functions over \(\mathbb Z\) and \(M=J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\), the source conjectures that \(M/\Lambda_+M\) requires \(\binom{a+b}{a}\) generators and suspects \[ M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}. \] It states that a proof had eluded the authors. [source-2@L1517-L1552|claim=formal-document]
- claim-8: The related type-\(A_{n-1}\) open question asks for a minimal generating set of \(I_w\), at least for varieties defined by inclusions (there stated to avoid \(4231,35142,42513,351624\)) or smooth varieties (there stated to avoid \(3412,4231\)). [source-2@L1913-L1929|claim=formal-document]
- claim-9: \(\Lambda_+\) occurs in the proposition and its application, but the supplied source passage does not explicitly define \(\Lambda_+\); only the grading \(\Lambda=\bigoplus_{n\ge0}\Lambda_n\) is stated. [source-2@L1520-L1540|claim=formal-document]
## Strategy
State the downstream specification from the validated ledger:
- \(v_{r,s,t,n}\), its parameter range, descents, and explicit one-line form: [source-2@L973-L992|claim=formal-document].
- \(i=s-t+1,\ j=r-t+1\), rectangle \(i^j\): [source-2@L1354-L1362|claim=formal-document]; \(\schubp_v=s_{i^j}\): [source-2@L1380-L1383|claim=formal-document].
- \(J_v\)'s displayed Grassmannian generating interval: [source-2@L1365-L1375|claim=formal-document].
- \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and both Theorem-5.4 families: [source-2@L1380-L1402|claim=formal-document].
- Distinguish: minimality conjecture and reported finite computer check [source-2@L1489-L1502|claim=formal-document]; quotient-generator conjecture and stronger suspected freeness [source-2@L1517-L1552|claim=formal-document]; related \(I_w\) question [source-2@L1913-L1929|claim=formal-document].

## Gaps
- Supplied evidence does not define \(J_v\), the parabolic \(J\), or \(I_w\); the generating descriptions do not supply those definitions.
- \(\Lambda_+\) is used but not explicitly defined in the supplied passage: [source-2@L1520-L1540|claim=formal-document].
- The source's “other than the identity” qualifier is relevant to the \(v_{r,s,t,n}\) parameterization: [source-2@L973-L975|claim=formal-document].
- Empty-range conventions in the displayed permutation and formal partition-concatenation conventions in \(((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\), \((i^j,b^a)\) are not supplied; only geometric descriptions appear at [source-2@L1407-L1413|claim=formal-document].
- “Minimal,” minimum required cardinality, and suspected freeness are distinct assertions. The computational statement is only a reported verification for \(r\le4,\ n-r\le5\), not proof.

## Next
Obtain exact source-2 locators defining \(J_v\), \(J\), \(I_w\), and \(\Lambda_+\). Record any source convention for empty intervals and partition concatenation; otherwise retain these as unresolved downstream assumptions.
